faq.q: What is included in your tour packages?
faq.a: Each package lists stay, meals, transfers and sightseeing. We write down what is and is not included before you pay.

faq.q: Can I change the itinerary?
faq.a: Yes. Packages can be adjusted for days, hotels and activities. A change may alter the cost, which we tell you first.

faq.q: Do you help with international travel documents?
faq.a: We guide you on the documents needed. Visa decisions rest with the embassy, and we do not promise approval.

faq.q: What happens if I need to cancel?
faq.a: Cancellation terms depend on airlines and hotels. We share them with you at booking so you know before paying.

faq.q: Can you book only flights or hotels?
faq.a: Yes. You can book just tickets, just a stay or a full package, whichever suits your plan.

faq.q: Can I bring my own caterer and decorator?
faq.a: Yes, in most cases. Please check our booking terms about outside vendors when you visit.

faq.q: How many guests can the hall hold?

faq.q: Is a sound system available?

faq.q: Which plants are right for my balcony?
faq.a: It depends on sunlight and space. We visit, check the light and recommend plants that cope with your conditions.

faq.q: How often should a lawn be mowed?
faq.a: It depends on the season and grass type. We set a schedule, often every one or two weeks in growing months.

faq.q: Do you supply plants and pots?
faq.a: Yes. We bring plants from our nursery, along with pots, soil mix and compost, and plant them for you.

faq.q: Can you maintain my garden every month?
faq.a: Yes. A gardener visits on fixed days for pruning, weeding, feeding and basic pest care.

faq.q: Will plants survive the summer heat?
faq.a: Many can with the right choice and watering. We select hardy plants and explain how to care for them in peak summer.
